places.name: V&A Dundee
places.ai_summary: A striking museum of design, showcasing innovative exhibits and Scotland’s rich cultural heritage along the River Tay.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the waterfront views from the museum’s terrace.

places.name: Discovery Point & RRS Discovery
places.ai_summary: Explore the polar ship Discovery and learn about Dundee’s maritime heritage at this award-winning visitor centre.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour for an in-depth experience.

places.name: The McManus: Dundee’s Art Gallery & Museum
places.ai_summary: A beautifully restored Victorian building housing a diverse range of art and historical artifacts.
places.name_english: The McManus: Dundee’s Art Gallery & Museum
places.place_tip: Check out the stunning architecture of the building itself.

places.name: Dundee Law Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular spot for panoramic views of the city, the River Tay, and across to Fife.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.name: Camperdown Wildlife Centre
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly attraction home to a variety of animals, including red pandas, otters, and birds of prey.
places.place_tip: Check the feeding times for a more interactive experience.

attribution.title: Camperdown House
attribution.author: Ydam
attribution.description: This is a photo of listed building number

places.name: Broughty Castle Museum
places.ai_summary: A historic castle offering insights into the local history of Broughty Ferry and stunning views of the Tay Estuary.
places.place_tip: Explore the castle grounds and enjoy a walk along the beach.

attribution.title: Broughty Castle - geograph.org.uk - 6000068
attribution.author: Mat Fascione
attribution.description: Broughty Castle

places.name: Mills Observatory
places.ai_summary: The only public astronomical observatory in the UK, offering stargazing opportunities and a chance to learn about astronomy.
places.place_tip: Visit on a clear night for the best stargazing experience.

places.name: Verdant Works
places.ai_summary: A living museum of industrial life, telling the story of Dundee’s jute industry and its impact on the city.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a more in-depth understanding.

places.name: University of Dundee Botanic Garden
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and tranquil garden showcasing a wide variety of plants, trees, and flowers from around the world.
places.place_tip: Visit the glasshouses for a tropical experience.

places.name: Maggie’s Penguin Parade Sculptures (seasonal)
places.ai_summary: A delightful outdoor art installation featuring life-sized penguin sculptures, created by local artists.

opening_hours.notes: Available for a limited time each year, check dates.

places.place_tip: Look out for the penguin trail map to find all the sculptures.

places.name: HMS Unicorn
places.ai_summary: A preserved 19th-century warship, now a museum, offering a glimpse into Dundee’s maritime history.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the deck and imagine life at sea.

places.name: Slessor Gardens
places.ai_summary: A public park and garden area with beautiful landscaping, sculptures, and a children’s play area.

opening_hours.notes: Open daily, hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic and the views of the River Tay.

places.name: Magdalen Green
places.ai_summary: A large public park with mature trees, flower beds, and a popular spot for picnics and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Open daily, hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Look out for the annual Magdalen Green Fair.

places.name: Dundee Contemporary Arts (DCA)
places.ai_summary: A vibrant arts venue showcasing contemporary art, film, and design, with a café and shop.
places.place_tip: Check the schedule for current exhibitions and screenings.

attribution.title: DundeeContemporaryArtsFacade2020s
attribution.author: KeyKing666
attribution.description: The facade of the Dundee Contemporary Arts, pictured in 2021.

places.name: Howff Cemetery
places.ai_summary: A historic cemetery with impressive tombstones and mausoleums, offering a peaceful retreat in the city.
places.place_tip: Respect the quiet and tranquility of the cemetery.

attribution.title: The original west gate, the Howff Cemetery
attribution.author: Stephencdickson
attribution.description: The original west gate, the Howff Cemetery

places.name: Tay Rail Bridge Views
places.ai_summary: Stunning views of the iconic Tay Rail Bridge, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the north or south approach.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a closer view of the bridge details.

attribution.description: Tay Road Bridge From the western end of Tay Street, Newport, looking across to Dundee and the hills.

places.name: Barnhill Rock Garden
places.ai_summary: A hidden gem featuring a variety of rock garden plants, alpine flowers, and stunning views over the city and river.
places.place_tip: Take care on the paths, especially when wet.

attribution.title: Craighouse from the pier - geograph.org.uk - 755742
attribution.author: Gordon Hatton
attribution.description: Craighouse from the pier Looking across the bay towards the north end of the village with the church to the right of centre and the Paps in the distance.

places.name: St Paul’s Cathedral Dundee
places.ai_summary: An impressive cathedral known for its stunning architecture, beautiful stained glass, and peaceful gardens.
places.place_tip: Attend a service or concert for a unique experience.
places.address: The Cathedral Church of St Paul, Dundee, Scotland

places.name: Caird Hall
places.ai_summary: A concert hall and event venue, known for its excellent acoustics and diverse program of events.
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.name: St Andrews Day Trip (nearby)
places.ai_summary: Visit the historic town of St Andrews, famous for its university, golf course, and beautiful coastal views.
places.place_tip: Explore the university campus and the ruins of the cathedral.
